info.title: Donadomains API
info.description:
Domain search aggregator — compare registration prices across 6 registrars (GoDaddy, Namecheap, Dynadot, Hover, Name.com, Porkbun) in real-time. Also provides detailed domain intelligence via RDAP and DNS.

Use cases:
- Find available domains for a keyword or brand name
- Compare prices across registrars and find the cheapest
- Check if a specific domain is taken
- Look up domain ownership, expiry, registrar, nameservers

No authentication required. All prices are live-scraped, not cached.

externalDocs.description: Full API documentation with interactive examples

get.summary: Search domain availability and compare prices across registrars
get.description: Scrapes 6 registrar search pages in parallel and returns merged results with live pricing. Each available domain includes buy links from every registrar that has it, with the cheapest option flagged. Taken domains are also returned (with empty buyLinks). Supports SSE streaming for progressive results.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search keyword (e.g. "startup") or full domain (e.g. "startup.io"). A bare keyword returns results across all TLDs. Including a TLD prioritizes that exact domain in results.

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: Set to "true" for Server-Sent Events streaming. Results arrive progressively as each registrar completes (2-15 seconds). Recommended for real-time UIs.

200.description: Search results with pricing from multiple registrars

schema.description: Server-Sent Events stream. Each event is a JSON object prefixed with 'data: '. Event types: init (registrar list), batch (results so far), complete (stream ends).

get.description: Returns comprehensive domain intelligence for a single domain. Queries RDAP (registrar, dates, status, contacts) and DNS-over-HTTPS (nameservers, resolution) in parallel. Falls back to who.is scraping when RDAP data is sparse. Response time is typically 1-2 seconds.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Fully qualified domain name. Must be lowercase alphanumeric with dots/hyphens, ending in a valid TLD.

SearchResponse.description: Top-level search response containing merged results from all registrars.

tld.description: Extracted TLD if the query included one (e.g. ".io"), null otherwise

results.description: Domain results sorted by: available first, exact matches first, popular TLDs first, most registrar coverage first.

sources.description: Status of each registrar scrape — check this to see which registrars succeeded or failed.

DomainResult.description: A single domain with availability status and pricing from registrars.

available.description: true if the domain can be registered, false if taken or premium

matchType.description: "exact" if domain is keyword+TLD, "similar" for suggestions (e.g. keyword variations)

buyLinks.description: Purchase links from registrars, sorted cheapest first. Empty array for taken domains.

registerUrl.description: Direct URL to the cheapest registrar for quick purchase. Only present when buyLinks is non-empty.

BuyLink.description: A purchase link from a single registrar with live pricing.

url.description: Direct purchase URL — takes the user to the registrar's checkout page

priceNum.description: Numeric price in USD for sorting/comparison

isCheapest.description: true if this is the lowest price across all registrars for this domain

premium.description: true if this is a premium or aftermarket listing (not standard registration)

source.description: How the price was obtained. Always "scraped" (live from registrar website).

SourceStatus.description: Status of a single registrar's scrape during the search.

status.description: "ok" if the registrar returned results, "failed" if scrape timed out or errored

count.description: Number of domain hits returned by this registrar (0 if failed)

DomainIntel.description: Comprehensive domain intelligence gathered from RDAP, DNS, and optionally who.is.

domain.description: The normalized domain that was queried

registered.description: true if the domain is currently registered, false if available

status.description: ICANN domain status codes (e.g. "client transfer prohibited", "client delete prohibited")

expires.description: Expiration date (ISO 8601) — useful for monitoring domains that may become available

registrar.description: Name of the registrar holding the domain (e.g. "MarkMonitor Inc.", "GoDaddy.com, LLC")

registrant.description: Name of the domain registrant — often "REDACTED FOR PRIVACY" when privacy protection is enabled

contactEmail.description: Registrant contact email — only present when not privacy-protected

contactAddress.description: Registrant postal address — usually partially or fully redacted

nameservers.description: Authoritative DNS nameservers for the domain

sources.description: Which data sources were used to gather this intelligence

example.description: Example of correct usage (included on some errors)
